scenes.narration: One script stops a bad page before you see it.

cites.snippet: the four checks an explain artifact must pass

bullets.text: Render: a sheet or a page

scenes.narration: The first check looks for remote links. The second check tests each citation. The third check lints the prose. A sheet or a page also gets a render check.

cites.snippet: a page two (1440x900, 500x844); a video none.

scenes.narration: Chrome opens the page by its file address. The function swaps four risky characters for safe codes. Then it adds a mark for the page check.

cites.snippet: Percent-encode the characters that would end or corrupt

scenes.narration: Without the script, a person checks each item by hand. Now one command runs every check and prints one line for each.

cites.snippet: Every check runs even after an earlier one failed
